newsitem.title: USA: Scattered 3-5 cts protection taken on US soy-trade.
newsitem.headline: Scattered 3-5 cts protection taken on US soy-trade.

text.p: Scattered cash protection of three to five cents per bushel on soybeans was reported in U.S. Midwest grain markets Monday and isolated protection of one cent on corn and two cents on wheat, grain dealers said.

The protection was taken in anticipation of lower CBOT grain and soybean futures because of beneficial rain moving across the U.S. Midwest. Also, soybeans were expected to be pressured by market talk a U.S. grain firm may be importing more soybeans from South America.
CBOT traders called soybean futures five to 10 cents lower at Monday's opening.
